title: Roof Repair in Sandy, OR
summary: In March 2026, French Roofing repaired a shingle roof in Sandy, OR, where two roof slopes meet in a valley. The crew pulled the shingles back along the valley, put down new underlayment, and laid new CertainTeed Landmark shingles back in across it. The finished valley sits in neat, even rows tied into the existing shingles on both sides.
scope: Pulled the shingles back along the valley, down to the underlayment
Rolled new underlayment down the valley
Laid new CertainTeed Landmark shingles back in and tied them into the existing roof

faqs.question: Was the whole roof replaced on this Sandy job?
faqs.answer: No. The work stayed on the valley. The shingles there came up, new underlayment went down, and new shingles were laid back in and tied into the rest of the roof.
